Prikker og bokser: Tegn streker mellom p: Dots and boxes: draw lines between the dots. Whoever closes a box gets it – and the most boxes wins.
Dere bytter på å tegne én strek mellom t: Take turns drawing one line between two dots next to each other – across or down.
Tegner du den fjerde siden av en boks, e: If you draw the fourth side of a box, the box is yours. Then you draw another line.
Når alle strekene er tegnet, teller dere: When every line is drawn, count the boxes. Whoever has the most wins.
Ikke tegn den tredje siden av en boks –: Don't draw the third side of a box – your opponent gets it for free.
Til slutt må noen gi bort en hel rekke b: In the end someone has to give away a whole chain of boxes. Give away the shortest.
Proff-triks: Ta alle boksene i en lang r: Pro trick: take every box in a long chain except the last two. Give those away, and your opponent has to open the next chain.
Du kan trykke litt ved siden av en strek: You can tap just beside a line – the nearest free line is drawn.
